policy: No full Strong's or TSK dataset becomes public until the source URL, license, commercial-use status, attribution requirements, parser quality, and review status are documented. Staged imports remain hidden until promoted.

source_candidates.title: OpenBible.info Bible Cross References
source_candidates.rights_status: Creative Commons Attribution License unless otherwise indicated.
source_candidates.license_summary: OpenBible states the data draws primarily from public-domain sources, especially Treasury of Scripture Knowledge, and licenses content under Creative Commons Attribution unless otherwise indicated. Import references only; do not import ESV quotations.
source_candidates.commercial_use_status: Needs attribution review before public import.
source_candidates.next_action: Download the zip, parse reference pairs only, preserve OpenBible attribution, and stage a 50-reference sample for review.

source_candidates.title: MetaV CrossRefIndex
source_candidates.rights_status: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 per local rights review.
source_candidates.license_summary: The repository describes CrossRefIndex as compiled from public-domain TSK tradition, but its distributed files carry CC BY-SA obligations.
source_candidates.commercial_use_status: Share-alike implications need acceptance before public import.
source_candidates.next_action: Keep as alternate path only; do not promote unless share-alike obligations are explicitly accepted.

source_candidates.title: STEPBible Data Repository
source_candidates.rights_status: CC BY 4.0 according to the current repository readme.
source_candidates.license_summary: STEPBible says the data may be included in software/publications without requesting permission, with credit to STEP Bible and notes for changes/corrections.
source_candidates.commercial_use_status: Promising, but exact files and attribution language must be reviewed before public import.
source_candidates.next_action: Identify exact lexicon and tagged-Bible files needed, stage a small sample, and record transformation notes.

source_candidates.title: CrossWire KJV 1769 with Strong's Numbers and Morphology
source_candidates.rights_status: Module notes describe KJV with embedded Strong's numbers and source acknowledgements; base KJV text rights and module permissions require careful review.
source_candidates.license_summary: CrossWire documents embedded Strong's numbers with OT data from Bible Foundation and NT data from KJV2003. Do not import until module license and base-text handling are documented.
source_candidates.next_action: Use only for source review/provenance until exact redistribution terms are approved.

source_candidates.title: Original Strong's Exhaustive Concordance Public-Domain Scan
source_candidates.rights_status: Likely public domain by publication age when an original pre-1931 edition is selected.
source_candidates.license_summary: Use as evidence and OCR verification source, not as an automatic structured import.
source_candidates.next_action: Select an exact scan, record publication data, spot-check OCR quality, and use it to verify lexicon entries.
